origin: HSL v1.06 under Wine, read-only tools/hsl_original_probe_units.py (hsl_win32_memread.exe). Trip 1 loaded the retired entry_level-5 form of the 回憶錄 preset level05_pre_battle; trip 2 loaded the current point form (standing at 米蘭多, one click on 呼嘯平原). Player input was 待機 only.
round_counter_note: round_counter_0x4c1e8c (kept as recorded) is a mislabel: 0x4c1e8c is the global RNG 0x458c10 seeded flag (clock-seeded while 0, 0x458bc3 sets it to 1); the round counter is 0x4c1bbc u16 (0x42c6b9 sets 1, 0x4074f1 inc per round), runtime-measured in static_reverse/original_enemy_turn.json. The value 1 in every snapshot below means seeded.
record_layout: docs/evidence_packets/static_reverse/original_save_format.md (0x1fc live record; grid = object +4/+8 ÷ 32); ai_words decoded from record_hex at the loader offsets of docs/evidence_packets/static_reverse/original_ai_navigation.md (wait_round +0x1b8, find_type +0x1c0, find_range +0x1c8, ai_call_range +0x1cc, ai_fixed +0x1d0, ai_check_dying +0x1d4, ai_check_hp +0x1d8, ai_lock +0x1e8)
